# MassConservationInductiveBias

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
An inductive bias enforcing conservation of a scalar quantity (e.g., energy or particle count) in Neural Cellular Automata (NCA) reservoirs to promote self-organized criticality. Enables NCA reservoirs to naturally operate near criticality, improving computational capacity and stability for neuromorphic in-network processing.
